comment: Under RH, |Gamma(1/2+i gamma)|^2 = pi sech(pi gamma) exactly; these are the amplitudes of the fully diagonal level-2 term and of the level-1 term in the LAPLACE form of the k-linear explicit formula. Their minuteness is the amplification-amplitude trade-off: each extra level costs a factor ~ e^{-pi gamma_1 / 2} = 2.277e-10.
